title: qa runner kit: write the v18.4.0 sweep's 12 environment facts into RUNNER.md and fix two qa-fixture.mjs gaps (walled-boot flags, contributor-member --position)
body:
domain:devx#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5ooRyyS95kdyC2dPEX

Filing gate: ① a named-carrier defect in the QA runner kit, with reach: each row below was hit in a real v18.4.0 sweep run (records #32953, #33025, #33048, #33081, #33092–#33094) and cost that run a detour, a wrong result or a re-drive.
Parent: #32908 (v18.4.0 sweep anchor), close-out ledger 6881013689: these 14 rows were parked as "out of scope" for the item-text batches (#33328–#33332) because they land in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` and `scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs`, not in `areas/*.json`.

**Business reason:** every release sweep is run by an agent reading RUNNER.md and calling `qa-fixture.mjs`. A missing environment fact (127.0.0.1 refused 403 INVALID_ORIGIN, `--no-compile` serving another runner's dist, uploads written into the tree) or a fixture command that rewrites the shared showcase artifact costs each run time and can turn a correct product into a false FAIL. Release cadence makes that recur every sweep.
**Reader:** `domain:devx` seat 4 dispatches it (one PR: RUNNER.md text + `qa-fixture.mjs`).
**Dedupe:** `"walled-boot" no-compile` and `RUNNER.md DEV_PROXY_TARGET` issue searches (open and closed): 36 and 4 hits, all QA run records and sweep anchors that report these facts; no card carries the fix. `plugin-email` `startFakeSmtp` port (row 14) is a `domain:server` package and is NOT on this card.

## Fix shape
- `scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs`: `walled-boot` passes `--no-compile --no-watch` (row 12, about L335) so it neither rewrites the shared showcase artifact nor starts a watcher; `contributor-member` grows a `--position` flag so the approvals persona needs no separate POST (row 13). Re-read both on current `main` first; a test for each if the script has a test harness.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`: one sentence per still-true environment fact (rows 86–269), each re-measured on current `main`. A row that reads as a product defect rather than an environment fact (e.g. row 94, a connector self-URL that ignores `OS_PORT` while RUNNER says it follows it) is reported, not written up as a workaround.
